name: Mobile & Android Emulator (Mobile & Emulator)
description: Provides Android ADB connection, emulator control, screen tap/swipe, text input, screenshot capture, and iOS Simctl controls

MobileDevices.description: Scan and list connected Android devices, emulators (MuMu, LDPlayer, Nox), or iOS simulators

MobileTap.description: Simulate touch tap or double tap at coordinates on mobile device screen

MobileSwipe.description: Simulate finger swipe gestures or drag-and-drop operations on screen

MobileInput.description: Input text into focused field on mobile device with Unicode support

MobileScreenCap.description: Capture high-speed screenshot of current device screen into image or file

MobileStartApp.description: Launch designated application on mobile device by package name or bundle ID

MobileStopApp.description: Force stop or terminate a running application on the mobile device

MobileInstall.description: Silently install an APK or IPA package file onto the target device

MobileUninstall.description: Uninstall designated application completely from target device

MobilePackages.description: Retrieve list of all installed packages (third-party or system) on the device

AdbShell.description: Execute arbitrary low-level Android Linux shell command via ADB and capture stdout

AdbKey.description: Send hardware key events (Home, Back, Power, Volume, Enter) to the device

AdbPush.description: Upload files or directories from host computer to mobile device storage

AdbPull.description: Download files or screenshots from mobile device storage to host PC

AdbForward.description: Forward socket connections from host port to device port over ADB

AdbConnect.description: Connect to an Android device over Wi-Fi/LAN via TCP/IP address and port

AdbRestartServer.description: Kill and restart background ADB server process to recover from frozen connections

SimctlBoot.description: Boot target iOS simulator instance via macOS simctl utility

SimctlShutdown.description: Safely shut down running iOS simulator instance

SimctlOpenUrl.description: Open URL webpage or trigger custom deep-link scheme inside iOS simulator

SimctlPermission.description: Pre-grant camera, photo, notification, or location permissions to iOS app

SimctlAddMedia.description: Inject photos or videos from host computer directly into iOS simulator photo library
